questions.q: Identify the conjunction relationship: “He was tired, so he went to bed early.”
questions.why: 'So' introduces a result. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: “She used to ____ up at five every morning.”
questions.why: 'Used to' (past habit) is followed by the bare infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Of the two medicines, this one is the ____.”
questions.why: Two items are compared, so the comparative 'better' is used. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct idiom: “The new scheme was a great success.” (meaning)
questions.why: 'Take off' = become successful; 'fall flat' and 'fall through' = fail. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “I go to ____ bed at ten every night.”
questions.why: 'Go to bed' (for sleep) uses no article. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “copious”:
questions.why: 'Copious' means abundant; 'ample' is closest. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “lucid”:
questions.why: 'Lucid' means clear and easily understood; 'obscure' means unclear. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “ephemeral”:
questions.why: Ephemeral = lasting a very short time. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “I prefer walking than driving to work.”
opts: I prefer walking to driving to work.
I prefer walking than to drive to work.
I prefer to walk than driving to work.
I prefer walk to drive to work.
questions.why: 'Prefer X to Y' with matching forms; 'than' is not used. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the clause type: “We left before the storm broke.”
questions.why: 'Before the storm broke' tells when. GPSC-style practice item.
